<section id="phoneme-inventory">
<h1>Phoneme Inventory</h1>
<p>kokorog2p uses the Kokoro TTS phoneme inventory, which is based on IPA (International
Phonetic Alphabet).</p>
<section id="kokoro-phoneme-set">
<h2>Kokoro Phoneme Set</h2>
<p>The Kokoro phoneme set consists of 45 phonemes plus punctuation markers.</p>
<section id="us-english-vowels">
<h3>US English Vowels</h3>
<section id="monophthongs">
<h4>Monophthongs</h4>

<colgroup>

<col style="width: 20.0%" />
<col style="width: 30.0%" />
<col style="width: 40.0%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="row-odd"><th class="head"><p>IPA</p></th>
<th class="head"><p>Name</p></th>
<th class="head"><p>Example Word</p></th>
<th class="head"><p>Phonemes</p></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>æ</p></td>
<td><p>TRAP</p></td>
<td><p>cat</p></td>
<td><p>kˈæt</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p>ɑ</p></td>
<td><p>LOT/PALM</p></td>
<td><p>father</p></td>
<td><p>fˈɑðɚ</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>ə</p></td>
<td><p>schwa</p></td>
<td><p>about</p></td>
<td><p>əbˈaʊt</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p>ɚ</p></td>
<td><p>r-colored schwa</p></td>
<td><p>butter</p></td>
<td><p>bˈʌtɚ</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>ɛ</p></td>
<td><p>DRESS</p></td>
<td><p>bed</p></td>
<td><p>bˈɛd</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p>ɪ</p></td>
<td><p>KIT</p></td>
<td><p>bit</p></td>
<td><p>bˈɪt</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>i</p></td>
<td><p>FLEECE</p></td>
<td><p>beat</p></td>
<td><p>bˈit</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p>ʊ</p></td>
<td><p>FOOT</p></td>
<td><p>book</p></td>
<td><p>bˈʊk</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>u</p></td>
<td><p>GOOSE</p></td>
<td><p>boot</p></td>
<td><p>bˈut</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p>ʌ</p></td>
<td><p>STRUT</p></td>
<td><p>cut</p></td>
<td><p>kˈʌt</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>ɔ</p></td>
<td><p>THOUGHT</p></td>
<td><p>caught</p></td>
<td><p>kˈɔt</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<p>Note: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">O</span></code> is a Kokoro-specific simplification of the GOAT vowel, used instead of <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">oʊ</span></code> in

<section id="punctuation">
<h3>Punctuation</h3>
<p>Kokoro supports the following punctuation marks:</p>
<div class="highlight-text notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>;  :  ,  .  !  ?  -
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Other punctuation is typically normalized or removed.</p>
</section>
</section>
<section id="british-english-differences">
<h2>British English Differences</h2>
<p>British English uses most of the same phonemes, with some key differences:</p>
<table class="docutils align-default">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 20.0%" />
<col style="width: 20.0%" />
<col style="width: 30.0%" />
<col style="width: 30.0%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="row-odd"><th class="head"><p>Phoneme</p></th>
<th class="head"><p>US Example</p></th>
<th class="head"><p>GB Example</p></th>
<th class="head"><p>Difference</p></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>ɑ → ɒ</p></td>
<td><p>lˈɑt (lot)</p></td>
<td><p>lˈɒt (lot)</p></td>
<td><p>LOT vowel</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p>ɔ → ɒ</p></td>
<td><p>kˈɔt (caught)</p></td>
<td><p>kˈɒt (caught)</p></td>
<td><p>THOUGHT vowel</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>ɚ → ə</p></td>
<td><p>bˈʌtɚ (butter)</p></td>
<td><p>bˈʌtə (butter)</p></td>
<td><p>Non-rhotic</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p>oʊ → əʊ</p></td>
<td><p>ɡˈoʊ (go)</p></td>
<td><p>ɡˈəʊ (go)</p></td>
<td><p>GOAT vowel</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</section>
<section id="german-phonemes">
<h2>German Phonemes</h2>
<p>German adds several phonemes not found in English:</p>
<section id="vowels">
<h3>Vowels</h3>
<table class="docutils align-default">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 10.0%" />
<col style="width: 20.0%" />
<col style="width: 30.0%" />
<col style="width: 40.0%" />
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr class="row-odd"><th class="head"><p>IPA</p></th>
<th class="head"><p>Name</p></th>
<th class="head"><p>Example Word</p></th>
<th class="head"><p>Notes</p></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>y</p></td>
<td><p>close front rounded</p></td>
<td><p>Tür</p></td>
<td><p>German ü (long)</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p>ʏ</p></td>
<td><p>near-close front rounded</p></td>
<td><p>Hütte</p></td>
<td><p>German ü (short)</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>ø</p></td>
<td><p>close-mid front rounded</p></td>
<td><p>schön</p></td>
<td><p>German ö (long)</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p>œ</p></td>
<td><p>open-mid front rounded</p></td>
<td><p>Köln</p></td>
<td><p>German ö (short)</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-even"><td><p>aː</p></td>
<td><p>long a</p></td>
<td><p>Vater</p></td>
<td><p>Length distinction</p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-odd"><td><p>eː</p></td>
<td><p>long e</p></td>
<td><p>gehen</p></td>
<td><p>Length distinction</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</section>

<section id="working-with-phonemes">
<h2>Working with Phonemes</h2>
<section id="validation">
<h3>Validation</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">kokorog2p</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">validate_phonemes</span>

<span class="c1"># Valid Kokoro phonemes</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="n">validate_phonemes</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;hˈɛlO wˈɜɹld&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Invalid phonemes</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">validate_phonemes</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;xyz123&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="getting-vocabulary">
<h3>Getting Vocabulary</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">kokorog2p</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">get_vocab</span>

<span class="c1"># Get US English vocabulary</span>
<span class="n">us_vocab</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">get_vocab</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;us&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">&quot;US vocabulary: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">us_vocab</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> phonemes&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Get GB English vocabulary</span>
<span class="n">gb_vocab</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">get_vocab</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;gb&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">&quot;GB vocabulary: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">gb_vocab</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> phonemes&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Print all phonemes</span>
<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">phoneme</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">us_vocab</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">phoneme</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="conversion-between-formats">
<h2>Conversion Between Formats</h2>
<section id="espeak-to-kokoro">
<h3>espeak to Kokoro</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">kokorog2p</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">from_espeak</span>

<span class="c1"># Convert espeak IPA to Kokoro format</span>
<span class="n">espeak_ipa</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;həlˈəʊ&quot;</span>
<span class="n">kokoro</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">from_espeak</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">espeak_ipa</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">variant</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;gb&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">kokoro</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># hˈɛlO or similar</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="kokoro-to-espeak">
<h3>Kokoro to espeak</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">kokorog2p</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">to_espeak</span>

<span class="c1"># Convert Kokoro to espeak IPA</span>
<span class="n">kokoro</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;hˈɛlO&quot;</span>
<span class="n">espeak</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">to_espeak</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">kokoro</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">variant</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;us&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">espeak</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>

      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
{% endraw %}
